title: The List Got Short
prompt:
[Intro: fingerpicked open-string electric guitar, alone]

[Verse 1: low weathered male voice, quiet]
I used to keep a hundred fires
Had to win, had to be seen
Every room a thing to conquer
Every man a thing to beat

[Verse 2: second guitar and bass enter]
Then the years came through like weather
Took the hair and took the pride
Took my father, took my hurry
Left a few things by my side

[Chorus: strings swell, voice stronger]
And the list got short
Three names and a dog
A porch, a little time
The list got short
And everything I dropped
Was never really mine

[Verse 3: drums enter, steady]
I don't need the last word anymore
I don't need to hold the floor
I know who I would run back for
I don't need a whole lot more

[Chorus: full band and orchestra]
And the list got short
Three names and a dog
A porch, a little time
The list got short
And everything I dropped
Was never really mine

[Guitar Solo: long, singing, melodic, over the orchestra]

[Bridge: band drops low, voice close]
Ask me what I'm proud of
I'll point across the room

[Final Chorus: biggest, then down to one guitar]
The list got short
Three names and a dog
A porch, a little time
The list got short
And everything I kept
Is here, and it is mine

[Outro: the opening guitar pattern, alone, slowing]
